info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Submission Amendment-spec
info.description: The Submission Amendment Management API enables users to create amendments for existing submission reports in the compliance banking domain. With this API, compliance officers and analysts can efficiently update submission details to reflect new information or changes in context. Users can leverage this capability to enhance compliance reporting accuracy and maintain regulatory requirements. This API streamlines the process of managing submission amendments, ensuring timely and accurate reporting for audits and reviews.

post.summary: Create an amendment for a specific compliance submission.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create an amendment for a specific compliance submission identified by its unique RES-100045 identifier. The amendment will be processed and associated with the compliance report, enabling users to update or correct submission details as necessary.
